extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides fast indexed browsing, unified search and recently played/resume lists, controls HLS quality and MP4 buffering, and can persist downloaded subtitles for replay.
extension.news: 0.6.3 - Preserve provider order in All views, add Date added sorting with persistent year labels, default search to both catalogues, move refresh actions into Settings, and add catalogue, subtitle and recent-media clearing controls.
